SWORD COMBO ANIMATIONS — 86a3719ee4a7e2e9fb27c7c152e29a741d3e930a
Native halfslash_128: 6 frames; native backslash_128: 13 frames. Matching original body, human head, shirt, pants, boots and steel arming-sword layers, with original oversized128 tiles. Revised wooden heater shield and metal trim follow the original off-hand animation in every attack and walk frame. Block uses the matching original combat_idle pose 0. Unsupported classic belt omitted consistently. Official body and cloth recolors only. No frames reversed, no new weapon pixels drawn. Per-component authors and OGA-BY3.0 / CC-BY-SA3.0 options above apply; source paths and hashes are recorded in each outfit-color manifest.
